scope: Authored P99 changes, P99 tools, and package configuration. Existing public baseline files are not rewritten.
limits: Pattern checks are a publication guard, not proof that arbitrary confidential information is absent.
Embedded archives and symlinks fail closed; inspect and publish only ordinary sanitized files.
Run final tests and bind the publication manifest after any edits. Historical receipts are not evidence that changed publication bytes were tested.

privateComparison.limits: Detects normalized four-line private snapshot overlap that is not present in the existing public baseline; not arbitrary paraphrases.

receiptScope: Post-sanitation support-artifact binding repair and public zone-scope provenance review. Re-run the public gate after any subsequent generated report, test receipt, or packaging edit.
